description: A full-bleed picture that owns its crop: a responsive image (art-directed phone source, focal point per breakpoint) behind a content region placed in the picture's calm area. For a landing hero, a section band or a portfolio cover; not for inline figures (use Image) or cards (use Card media). Parallax is CSS scroll-driven, transform only, and off under reduced motion. Preview until its stable evidence is recorded.

sizes.description: How tall the plate is: the first viewport (`viewport`), a section band (`band`), or an inset rounded card (`card`).

safeAreas.description: Where the content sits on the picture. `start` and `end` take half the width from the medium breakpoint up.

tones.description: Text over the picture: `page` keeps the theme's text roles (a calm plate in the page tone), `media` uses the on-media roles that hold on any picture.

veils.description: A gradient behind the safe area, in the tone's colour, to steady the text.
